title: NSGo game editor settings (version 1)
description:
EditorSettings holds per-user editor preferences saved outside any game project as versioned YAML. A file looks like this:

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://game.nsgo.dev/schemas/editor-settings.v1.json version: 1 language: system appearance: system

ParseEditorSettings decodes it strictly and EncodeEditorSettings writes it back in canonical form, so a file EncodeEditorSettings wrote survives a load and save byte for byte.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal SettingsVersion (1).

language.description: Language selects the editor UI language ("system", "en", or "zh").

appearance.description: Appearance selects the editor color scheme ("system", "light", or "dark").

autoSave.description: AutoSave controls whether kept edits save automatically after 2 seconds. When omitted, autosave is enabled by default.

interfaceSize.description: InterfaceSize scales editor text and controls together ("compact", "default", or "large"). When omitted, "default" is used.

snap.description: Snap holds per-user viewport snapping and 2D snap grid preferences (step in px, rotation step in degrees, grid overlay).

showAgentChanges.description: ShowAgentChanges controls whether viewport outlines highlight agent changes while a review is open. When omitted, outlines are shown by default.

navigation3D.description: Navigation3D selects the 3D viewport's mouse navigation mapping ("default", "blender", or "maya"). When omitted, "default" is used.

viewportOverlays.description: ViewportOverlays lists the enabled 2D viewport overlay IDs in canonical sorted order. When omitted, the editor uses DefaultViewportOverlays(); an empty list disables all overlays.

hiddenOverlayKinds.description: HiddenOverlayKinds lists Spec overlay legend kinds toggled off by the user ("selection", "agent", "added", "changed", "removed", "problem") in canonical sorted order.

overlayLegend.description: OverlayLegend lists the enabled Spec viewport overlay legend kinds ("selection", "agent", "added", "changed", "removed", "problem") in canonical sorted order. When omitted, all six legend kinds are enabled by default; an empty list hides all six kinds.

shortcuts.description: Shortcuts overrides default command shortcuts keyed by command ID (for example "view.frame": "g"). An empty string explicitly unbinds a command.

seenTips.description: SeenTips lists the onboarding tip IDs already seen or skipped by this user in canonical sorted order. Help › Replay tips clears the first-run review tip IDs so each tip shows again.

agent.description: Agent stores per-computer preferences for connected models, MCP tools, external MCP servers, weekly usage limit, and outbound privacy rules. Secrets such as API keys are never stored here.

AgentMCPServer.description: AgentMCPServer configures an external MCP server the agent may use alongside the editor's server. Entries configured here are written into the project's agent MCP configuration (.mcp.json and .codex/config.toml).

name.description: Name is the unique MCP server identifier (letters, digits, '_', '-').

title.description: Title is the display name shown in Settings › Tools (for example "Running game · nsgo dev").

description.description: Description briefly describes what the server offers (for example "inspect and drive the live game").

command.description: Command is the executable launched over stdio (for example "go").

args.description: Args are optional arguments passed to Command (for example ["tool", "nsgo", "mcp"]).

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether this server is included in the agent's MCP configuration (default true when omitted).

AgentPrivacySettings.description: AgentPrivacySettings is the YAML representation of WHAT MAY LEAVE THIS COMPUTER in EditorSettings. Omitted fields fall back to DefaultAgentPrivacyPolicy (SceneAndData=true, ViewportImages=true, GoSource=false, ArtAndAudio=false).

sceneAndData.description: SceneAndData allows MCP tools to return scene, prefab, data table, and project YAML files (default true).

viewportImages.description: ViewportImages allows viewport_image and frozen-frame tools to return PNG images (default true).

goSource.description: GoSource allows MCP tools to return Go source code and go.mod files (default false).

artAndAudio.description: ArtAndAudio allows MCP tools to return art and audio assets or metadata files (default false).

AgentSettings.description: AgentSettings stores per-computer AI agent preferences in editor.yaml (Settings › Agent group). Secrets such as API keys are NEVER stored in this struct or any file; they live exclusively in the OS keychain.

builtInProvider.description: BuiltInProvider names the built-in API connection configured in the system keychain (for example "Anthropic API"); never stores an API key.

routes.description: Routes maps task keys ("scene_edits", "playtest_analysis", "problems_fixes", "ask_in_place", "art_and_sound") to preferred model labels.

tools.description: Tools overrides per-tool MCP enabled state keyed by tool name (for example "game_delete_file": false).

mcpServers.description: MCPServers configures other MCP servers the agent may use alongside the editor's own server.

weeklyRequestLimit.description: WeeklyRequestLimit sets the weekly agent request budget (0 disables the limit; omitted defaults to 300).

privacy.description: Privacy controls WHAT MAY LEAVE THIS COMPUTER across every connected agent.

usage.description: Usage stores local usage counters (requests this week, kept review share, and local playtest runs).

approvedAutomations.description: ApprovedAutomations lists the projects whose automations.yaml the person allowed to run on this computer, one entry per project folder in canonical sorted order. A project's automations stay off until its file's current SHA-256 is listed here, because a cloned or pulled project writes that file.

AgentUsageStats.description: AgentUsageStats records per-computer local agent usage metrics persisted in editor.yaml. No prompts, file contents, or secrets are stored here.

weekStart.description: WeekStart is the UTC Monday date (YYYY-MM-DD) for WeeklyRequests, when recorded.

weeklyRequests.description: WeeklyRequests is the number of agent requests made during WeekStart's week.

reviewedChanges.description: ReviewedChanges is the total number of agent change reviews resolved (kept or reverted).

keptChanges.description: KeptChanges is the number of reviewed agent changes kept by the person.

playtestRuns.description: PlaytestRuns is the number of local headless playtest runs recorded on this computer.

ApprovedAutomations.description: ApprovedAutomations records that the person allowed one project's automations.yaml, exactly as it was when they allowed it, to run on this computer.

project.description: Project is the absolute path of the project folder.

sha256.description: SHA256 is the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the automations.yaml bytes the person allowed.

SnapSettings.description: SnapSettings holds the editor's snapping and 2D grid overlay preferences. They are editor preferences persisted per project in ViewStateFile (.game/editor.yaml), never in scene files.

grid.description: Grid snaps object placement, drags, 2D handles, and 3D translate gizmos to EffectiveGridStep.

gridSize.description: GridSize is an explicit grid step in world/layer units; 0 means follow the active layer's tilemap tile size (or 8 when it has none).

pixel.description: Pixel snaps positions to whole points (1-unit increments) when Grid is off.

rotation.description: Rotation snaps 2D and 3D rotation drags to RotationStepDeg-degree increments.

rotationStepDeg.description: RotationStepDeg is the rotation snap step in degrees (defaults to 15 when <= 0).

scale.description: Scale snaps 2D and 3D scale drags to ScaleStep increments.

scaleStep.description: ScaleStep is the scale snap step (defaults to 0.25 when <= 0).

showGrid.description: ShowGrid draws a 2D grid overlay at the active snap step in the 2D edit viewport, following View2D.
